answer: With a Dedicated device bound by one-time code delivery with annual re-verification, the account is only as strong as its binding: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The design treats each channel as a juniper: small alone, decisive in aggregate. From the dune to the island, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
